description: cvrt-lang 0.10.0+: export Lang's own data (GET /export: languages, settings, content types, field policies, switcher, object links, strings, status; no secrets) into a NEW JSON file on this machine (out_path: absolute, ends in .json, must not exist; created 0600, never a partial file; a process killed mid-write can leave a hidden `.<8 hex>.tmp` file in that directory). Returns the file, its bytes and row counts per section only, never the data. Feed the file to lang_import.

out_path.description: Absolute path of a new .json file on this machine (refused if anything exists there)

name: lang_export
